book.name: ROMANOS
book.title: JA' AN SCARTA NAJ PABLO TET EB CREYENTE BEY ROMA

content: Chi Sna' Oc Dios Yin Masanil Ánima Yin Caw Yel

Yal c'al mac txequel junoj jon chi cu na' oc yin junoj xa mac txequel, ma ske' kaloni tol c'am cu penail. Yutol ja' yet chi cu na'on oc yin junoj xa mac txequel, lalan ki'ontej sya'tajilal kiban. Yutol ja' yet lalan cu na'on oc yin junoj xa mac txequel, laan tzet chi el kunen yetoj.
Kotaj, tol yal c'al mac txequel jaxca tu' chi yute sba, ja' Dios oj na'on oc yin caw yel. Oj yak' sya'tajilal yiban.

Ja' jaex che na' oc yin eb chi unen man watx' oj tu'. ¿Tumi oj ske' je colon el je ba yalan sjowal sc'ul Dios oj jul yiban eb chi unen man watx' oj tu', che na'? Pero quey tu' che yute pax je ba jaxca eb tu'.

Ja' Dios caw miman swatx' c'ulal, caw ey smiman c'ulal. Man comon oj chi tit sjowal sc'ul Dios. Pero tejan ey jex c'am yel oc apnoj wan ti' yul je sat. ¿Tumi man je yotaj oj tol chi yak' miman c'ulal kiban, yet watx' chi yak' sna' sba cu c'ul?

Pero jaex, c'am che jije pax oj. C'am che na' el nioj je ba. Yuxan lalan c'al je yamban oc sjowal sc'ul Dios je yiban. Ja' yet oj jul jun sc'ual sya'tajil je yet c'al el oj, ja' yet jun c'ual tu' oj txeclo el oj, tol watx' c'al lalan yunen sna'on oc Dios yin eb masanil.
Ja' yet jun c'ual tu', oj ẍa' spaj sq'uexel ja'ta'c'ala' tzet jix el yunen jun jun ánima.

Ey eb bey oj yak' jun k'inale tol ey c'al yin tobal k'inal, ja' ton eb tec'an chi yute sba yin yunen swatx'ilal, catu' chi seyon swatx'ilal Dios chi txeclo el yin eb, catu' miman yel oc apnoj Dios yul sat eb. Catu' chi seyon jun k'inale eb ey c'al yin tobal k'inal.

Pero ey eb, asan yet ey yel oc apnoj yul sat. C'am chi sjije cuybanile caw yel. Asan yin tzet c'am swatx'il ey oc sna'bal eb. Caw miman sjowal sc'ul Dios oj tit yiban eb, catu' oj yaon oc sya'tajil Dios yiban eb.
Masanil c'al eb chi unen tzet yetal man watx' oj, oj yab sya'tajilal eb sic'lebil. Yel xa c'al ec'ban oj utele eb wet Israelal, pero oj yab pax sya'ilal eb man Israel oj.

Ja' masanil eb watx' chi yute sba, ja' swatx'ilal Dios oj yak' tet eb, catu' miman yel oc apnoj eb yul sat Dios. Ey watx' c'ulal snan xol eb c'al yetoj Dios. Ja' eb wet Israelal watx' chi yute sba, yel xa c'al ec'ban oj yun yak'on wan ti' tet eb, catu' oj yak'on pax tet eb man Israel oj.
Yutol ja' yul sat Dios, laan c'al yel oc apnoj jun jun ánima.

Masanil eb man otajnen oj sley Moisés, ta tol c'am swatx'il sbeybal eb, oj ale can toj eb bey camich yin junelne. Pero manaj jun ley tu' oj aon can toj eb bey sya'tajil. Pero masanil eb otajnen jun ley tu', pero lalan c'al pax yunen spenail eb, ja'c'al oc jun ley tu' oj ak'balnele oj, catu' oj ilchatej yin eb.
Yutol ja' eb asan tu' c'al chi aben tzet chi yal jun ley tu', man watx' oj eb yul sat Dios. Ja' eb chi jijen tzet chi yala, ja' ton eb, watx' yul sat Dios.
Ja' eb man Israel oj, man yotaj oj eb sley Moisés, pero ja' yet asan yu sna'bal eb chi yun tzet chi yal jun ley tu', cax c'al man yotaj oj jun ley, jaxca tol ja' jun ley tu', ey oc yin sna'bal eb.

Ja' sbeybal eb chi tx'oxon el oj, tol ey oc jun ley tu' yin sna'bal eb. Ja' jun sna'bal eb chi ak'on cuenta. Jaxca tu' chi yute x'oxon el sba eb, tol ey oc jun ley tu' yin sna'bal eb, c'al yotajnen el eb yin sna'bal, ta watx' chi el yunen eb ma pena.
Ja' yet oj jul jun c'ual oj sna' oc Dios yin masanil ánima yu tzettaj ewan c'uan ye yu eb, ja' Jesucristo oj na'on oc yin eb, jaxca chi yal jun k'ane yet colbanile chi wal ti' an.
Ja' Tzet Yopiso Sley Moisés Yu Eb Israel
Pero jaex, che jelanne je ba yutol a Israel jex, catu' asan sley Moisés che yaoc yip oj je c'ul. Caw che yec'banne je ba, yutol sconob Dios jex.
Je yotaj xa tzet chi yoche Dios. Je yotaj pax oj, beytet watx' tzet chi el kuneni, yutol cuywinaj jex yin sley Moisés.
Ey eb man otajbil oj Dios yu. Catu' ey jex chi ske' je tx'oxon Dios tet eb, je na'oni. Ey eb jaxca chi ec' spixan eb xol k'ej k'inal, chi ske' je yak'on saj k'inal tet eb, je na'oni.

Ja' je na'oni tol chi ske' je cuyon eb c'am tzet yotaj. Catu' chi ske' je yak'on na'cha el yu eb c'am chi na'cha el yu, je na'oni. Yu sley Moisés, yuxan caw chi na'cha el wan cuybanile tu' je yu. Je yotaj xa beytet yel.
Caw cuywawom jex tet wanoj xa mac txequel. Pero, ¿Tzet yuxan c'am che cuy pax je ba? Che yala, tol c'am chi ske' kelk'anwi, pero elk'om jex pax oj.
Che yala, tol c'am chi ske' cu mulwi, pero chex mulwi pax oj. Caw c'am che yoche wan tzet yetal chi al-le oc sdiosal, pero elk'om jex pax bey ey oc wan dios tu'.
Yutol je yotaj sley Moisés, yuxan ec'ban che yute je ba. Pero c'am che jije pax tzet chi yal jun ley tu'. Yuxan caw chi buchle el Dios je yu.
Ja' yul An Juun chi yal can jaxca ti': “Yu je beybal, yuxan chi buchwa eb man Israel oj yin Dios,” ẍi yul An Juun.

Yel toni, ey yopiso jun yechel chi yij sbi circuncisión, ta che jije tzet chi yal sley Moisés. Pero ta c'am che jije jun ley tu', jaxca tol man ey oj oc jun yechel chi yij circuncisión je yin yul sat Dios.
Jal pax eb man ey oj oc jun yechel tu' yin, jaxca tol ey oc jun yechel tu' yin eb yul sat Dios ta chi sjije eb tzet chi yal jun ley tu'.

Ey ton eb jaxca tu'. C'am jun yechel tu' ey oc yin eb, pero chi sjije eb jun ley tu'. Ja' eb oj na'on oc je yin. Cax c'al ey oc jun yechel tu' je yin, cax c'al tz'ibebil can jun ley tu' e ex, pero tutun c'am che jije.

Manaj eb chi yij sbi Israel yu ánima, manaj eb yel Israel yul sat Dios. Pero ja' eb caw yel ey oc sna'bal yin Dios, ja' ton eb tu' caw yel Israel yul sat Dios. Manaj eb ey oc jun yechel, chi yij circuncisión tu', yin smimanil eb, manaj eb yel ey oc jun yechel tu' yin eb yul sat Dios. Yutol ja' jun ja' caw yechel chi yij circuncisión yul sat Dios, ja' ton jun ey oc yin cu pixan. Man yu oj ley yuxan chi oc kin, pero yu tzetal ey oc yin cu pixan, yuxan chi oc kin. Yuxan man ánima oj chi aloni, tol watx' jon, pero ja' Dios chi aloni, tol watx' jon.
